data.title: 卡芙卡 · 蛛网言灵私密审讯
data.description: 【卡芙卡 · 蛛网言灵私密审讯】昏暗冰冷的金属审讯室内，微弱的单束顶光打下。卡芙卡微微俯身逼近，指尖缠绕着发光的深紫色灵能蛛丝，深邃迷离的紫色双瞳直视着镜头深处，轻启朱唇施展言灵之术——「听我的话……看着我的眼睛。把你所知道的一切，都一字不漏地告诉我吧。」
data.action: 俯身逼近镜头，指尖缠绕发光紫色蛛丝，眼神带着支配感与致命诱惑
data.lighting: 单束冰冷顶光射灯与紫色灵能蛛丝辉光
data.promptProse: Kafka leans toward the camera in the cold metal interrogation room, luminous purple psychic threads wound around her gloved fingertips as she holds an unwavering gaze. Her white lace collar and burgundy-black coat remain close in the high-angle portrait. The metal wall recedes just behind her shoulder. A single cold top spotlight shapes her face and glove, while the threads add violet reflections along her fingers and collar edge.
